content.text:
**Analyzing the Template**

I've got the template boundaries down, from (9,0) to (15,6). The markers at the corners are noted: color 2 at (1,1), color 3 at (1,5), color 8 at (5,1), and color 6 at (5,5). I'm also tracking the distractor color, which is 4. I've begun associating colors to cell locations outside of the core markers, for example, color 2 is located at cells (2,14) and (3,13).
